item.title: Hello 1.0.8
item.description:
Hello 1.0.8

  • Notetaker: when macOS refuses to let Hello hear a call even though the switch looks on, the Allow button now clears Hello's old permission entry and asks macOS again. No more removing and re-adding Hello by hand.
  • A meeting note that failed for this reason explains it in plain words and has the same Allow button.
  • Hello shows its window again after macOS quits and reopens it following a permission change, instead of coming back silently.
